sloka: तत्र धैर्यात् च शूराः तु राघवो न एव विव्यधे ।बाल्यात् अनाश्रयत्वात् च एव लक्ष्मणः तु अतिविव्यधे ॥३-६९-३७॥
transliteration: tatra dhairyāt ca śūrāḥ tu rāghavo na eva vivyadhe ।bālyāt anāśrayatvāt ca eva lakṣmaṇaḥ tu ativivyadhe ॥3-69-37॥

translations.english: Of the two heroes, Rama being courageous was not worried but Lakshmana being younger and not having as much courage, was very much concerned and depressed. He said to Rama:
